paite: Tangte lam ah ka mit ka suantou ding a; koi a kipan in ahia panpihna ahong tun ding?
heading: TOUPA, Ei Hon Humbittu

paite: Hon panpihna tuh TOUPA lei leh van bawlpa a pan ahong tung ding hi.
Ama'n na khe kisuan aphal kei ding a; nangmah chingpa alusu kei ding hi.
Ngai in Israelte chingpa alusu in a-ihmu sam kei ding hi.
TOUPA nangmah chingpa ahi; TOUPA na taklam a nang hon liahpa ahi.
Sun in nisa in ahon hai kei dia, zan in leng kha in ahon sun sam kei ding.
TOUPA'N hoih lou chiteng a pan ahon ching dia; na hinna aching ding hi.
TOUPA'N na pawt leh na lut aching ding a, tua kipan a, tangtawn in.
